pose-filter-sweep.method: Offline replay of runs recorded with the filter off: each shown pose sample updates the filter at its frame capture time, a lost face resets it, and each render predicts to the newest presented frame (eval/harness/poseReplay.mjs). Jitter is the RMS high-pass of what renders drew on rec-static (blinks masked); lags are on the motion clips against the frame on screen.
pose-filter-sweep.lags: position lag: the larger of the median lag to 90% on step-x and the delay on ramp-x; rotation lag: the delay on sine-roll
pose-filter-sweep.selection: Rotation, then translation with the chosen rotation: the least rec-static jitter among points with a lag under the target, else the least lag. The recommendation is the operating point with both lags under the target and the smallest worst ratio of position and rotation jitter to their targets.
